_comment: Cheapest first (OpenCode Go price, input+output per million). Each contract or question starts at the first non-demoted model and climbs at most max_models_per_item rungs. A model is demoted for this project after two confirmed failures: it exhausted its attempts and a later model passed the same item. Demoted models move to the end of the ladder; delete .codegen/models-state.json to reset. Edit by hand. Researcher failures are confirmed by the supervisor: `research --reject <id>` counts the report's model as failed and reruns the question with the next rung.
